title: "Interior Mutability with RefCell"
---

# Interior Mutability with RefCell
`RefCell<T>` enforces Rust's borrowing rules dynamically at runtime rather than at compile time:

```rust
use std::cell::RefCell;

fn main() {
    let val = RefCell::new(10);
    {
        let mut mut_borrow = val.borrow_mut();
        *mut_borrow += 5;
    }
    println!("Mutated value: {}", *val.borrow());
}
```
